definitions.explanation: An academic subject or course in school curriculum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{必修|ひっしゅう}→必修：08641_hisshuu⟧{科目|かもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}らなければならない→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I have to take required subjects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧{科目|かもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。

notes:
{科目|かもく} refers to a subject or course of study in an academic curriculum, typically at university level.

COMMON TYPES:
- ⟦{必修|ひっしゅう}→必修：08641_hisshuu⟧{科目|かもく}: required/compulsory subject
- ⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧{科目|かもく}: elective subject
- ⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧{科目|かもく}: specialized/major subject
- ⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧⟦{教養|きょうよう}→教養：noentry⟧{科目|かもく}: general education subject
- ⟦{基礎|きそ}→基礎：03981_kiso⟧{科目|かもく}: foundational subject

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {科目|かもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take a subject
- {科目|かもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to fail a subject
- {科目|かもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履修|りしゅう}する→履修する：04861_rishuu⟧: to register for a subject

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{教科|きょうか}→教科：noentry⟧: school subject (primary/secondary school)
- ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: class, lesson
- ⟦{講座|こうざ}→講座：noentry⟧: course, lecture series
- ⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧: credit (academic)
